verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no user-configurable automation or background agent capability in Capacities. The AI assistant 'can propose creates and updates for you to approve', which is approval-gated rather than autonomous, and AI auto-fill is an assistive feature, not an automation engine. Scheduled full export is a fixed, narrow feature adjacent to automations, and the API and MCP are developer building blocks, so neither earns credit for this story.
